status: All 24 planned Stack motion-comparison episodes completed and validated.
scope: Two frozen engineering Stack scenes, roots zero/one/two, identity and three fixed motion limits. Full original horizons; no optimizer or reserved evaluation.

batch_report.accounting_scope: Recorded episode costs include failed and incomplete work. Missing fields and unattached physics are explicit; totals may be partial. Elapsed seconds are sums across episodes, not batch wall time.
batch_report.interpretation: Outcome counts cover only validated completed episodes; all other planned jobs remain in statuses. A missing process record does not prove a process is live. This report makes no causal or safety guarantee.

interpretation: All 24 planned trials and all 18 condition/control comparisons are complete. Six identity trials are reused across the three candidate comparisons and count only once in whole-batch costs. Two individual safe-completion gains coexist with additional violations. Initial observations differ even for shared scene/root seeds; no causal repair, generalization or optimizer advantage is established.
